# Nour Aldeen Tofi

> Frontend & AI Engineer: React and TypeScript Interfaces, LLM Agents, Arabic Document AI, MCP · n8n Automation, based in Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia. I build React and TypeScript interfaces and the AI behind them: applications on large language models that take over manual work in Arabic and English.

Also known as: Nour Aldeen Tofi · Nouraldeen Tofi · Nour Al-Deen Tofi · Nour Al Deen Tofi · Nour Aldin Tofi · Nour Eddin Tofi · Noureddine Tofi · Nour El Din Tofi · Noor Aldeen Tofi · Nour Aldeen Toufi · Nour Tofi · nouraldeentofi · نور الدين طفي · نورالدين طفي · نور الدين الطفي · نور طفي

I build the interface people use and the AI behind it, in Arabic and English. Smart Scanner turns a photo of an invoice into checked data, and the shop sites I build take bookings and orders on WhatsApp.

- **Roles I am open to:** Frontend & AI Engineer, Frontend Developer (React, TypeScript, Next.js)
- **Locations:** Al Khobar, Dammam, Dhahran, Eastern Province, Riyadh and anywhere in Saudi Arabia (open to relocation), Remote
- **Work preferences:** Open to a full-time role

## What he offers

- [AI automation for repetitive work](https://nouraldeentofi.com/en/automation): Systems that take over what a team repeats by hand: reading invoices, screening CVs, replying to customers, and taking bookings and running daily admin through WhatsApp and Telegram bots. One example: for a chess club in Dammam, the system I built reads every bank-transfer receipt, so registrations are confirmed without anyone opening one by hand. We start from real samples of your work, and a person approves anything sensitive. Built with n8n and large language models.
- [Websites for professionals and businesses](https://nouraldeentofi.com/en/showcase): A site designed around you or your business, in Arabic, English or both, and fast on phones. For a shop or a restaurant: what you offer in photos, your place on the map, and ordering or booking through WhatsApp. One example: on the site of Al-Reem Grilled Lamb in Al Khobar, each order arrives ready on the shop's WhatsApp. Send me your LinkedIn profile, your company's current site or your shop's Google Maps listing, and I will tell you what I would build.
- [Frontend development for products and internal systems](https://nouraldeentofi.com/en/work): Web apps and internal tools in Arabic and English, with full right-to-left support. One example: at DFS, a safety-equipment company, I built the frontend of the CRM and quotation platform, and it replaced spreadsheets and hand-made quotes in every department. I agree the data contract with the backend first, so both sides build in parallel. Built with React, TypeScript and Next.js.

## Projects

- [Smart Scanner](https://receipt.nexleadtech.com) (2026): Arabic-first AI invoice management: from photo to approval, with zero manual data entry.
- [CV Screener](https://cv-screener.nouraldeentofi.com) (2026): Upload a folder of CVs and every one is read, classified, and scored by AI, with each point traced to a quote from the CV.
- Universal Web Scraper (2026): One link in, the whole site out: every page discovered, the data classified, and an Excel file with a tab for each kind of data.
- [Nour Motion Studio](https://nouraldeentofi.com/motion-studio/) (2026): Pick a size and a style, add ready-made scenes, and export a motion video for free, in the browser, with no account and no server.
- [Braille Certificate Maker](https://braille.nouraldeentofi.com/) (2026): Fill in a training certificate and get a print-ready PDF. It comes with a full Arabic Braille version a blind trainee can read by touch, and a file for Braille embossers.
- DFS Dashboard (2025 to 2026): A unified CRM and quotation platform that replaced scattered manual processes across every department.
- [Khatm · ختم](https://khatm.nouraldeentofi.com/) (2026): An open-source e-invoicing program for businesses in Saudi Arabia, with a public demo that issues and signs invoices entirely in the browser.
- [The Complete Umrah Guide](https://nouraldeentofi.com/umrah-guide/) (2026): An interactive Umrah checklist in the order the rites are performed, in ten languages, and built to be used one-handed and offline inside the Haram.
- [GoldenTag](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.leadbridge.golden_tag) (2025): A jewellery store management app shipped to the Google Play Store.
- Business Card Extractor (2026): Photograph a business card, and it lands in your phone's contacts in one tap.
- MCP Search Server (2026): A Model Context Protocol server that lets an AI model query real data instead of only generating text.

## Automation systems

- Universal Web Scraper (2026, Live): A shared engine fetches pages and escalates only as far as it must, reads structured data before it spends anything on AI, and writes the rows into a spreadsheet. Quick jobs and long crawls run as separate, controllable workers.
- CV Screener agents (2026, Live): The AI engine of CV Screener: sibling agents whose tasks include profiling one CV, screening one CV against a job, and summarising a whole pool. The product server calls them; every one checks a secret first, fences the CV as data, and returns typed JSON or a typed error.
- Teacher Assistant AI Bot (2026 to present, Running for a client): A natural-language Arabic assistant delivered to a private tutor in Saudi Arabia. The tutor manages students, schedules, cancellations, and dues entirely through chat. The AI agent calls custom CRUD tools under strict business rules rather than guessing.
- Smart Scanner Extraction Pipeline (2026, Private beta): The extraction pipeline behind Smart Scanner. Every invoice, whether a photo or a PDF, is verified as a real invoice, parsed with GPT-4.1 Vision, validated, deduplicated, and persisted. It reads Arabic, English, and mixed documents, and is tuned for handwritten Arabic invoices and Saudi e-invoice fields.
- Telegram Publishing System (2026, Built and tested): Plan, review, approve and publish posts to LinkedIn, Instagram and Reddit from a Telegram chat. The AI only understands what you meant; every decision after that is made by a deterministic state machine.
- Unified Inbox (2026, Built and tested): Messages from every channel land in one inbox. Each one is enriched with its dialect, intent, priority and a summary, plus a draft reply written in the sender's own dialect. Replies leave through an outbox that records every result.
- Google Review Reply Manager (2026, Built and tested): New Google reviews are picked up on a schedule and answered in the reviewer's own language. Happy reviews get a reply on their own; unhappy ones go to the owner on Telegram, who approves or skips with one tap.
- AI Job-Match Pipeline (2026, Live): A scheduled pipeline that runs five daily search queries across LinkedIn, Indeed, and Glassdoor, scores each role's fit from one to ten with a structured-JSON LLM evaluator, and delivers only the high scorers.
- Transfer Receipt Check (2026, Running for a client): Behind a chess club's tournament registration: the uploaded bank-transfer receipt is read by a vision model, which also says whether it is a transfer at all. The site applies the rules; the workflow only reads.
- WhatsApp Booking Bot (2026, Built and tested): A customer taps a service, then a time slot, in WhatsApp buttons. The confirmed slot is written to Google Calendar and confirmed back on WhatsApp.
- WhatsApp Group from a Spreadsheet (2026, Built and tested): Upload an Excel or CSV of contacts and a group name: the group is created, everyone is added in throttled batches, and anyone WhatsApp refuses to add receives the invite link instead.
- Social Auto-Publisher (2026, Built and tested): Send a post idea to a Telegram bot and get back captions for each platform and a branded image in your own colours, fonts and logo. Nothing is scheduled until you approve the preview.
- Smart Lead Finder (2025, Built and tested): Automated B2B lead generation across the Saudi and Jordanian markets: multi-query place search, website scraping to extract emails and WhatsApp numbers, prioritisation scoring, and duplicate-safe appends into segmented sheets.
- Lesson Quality Evaluator (2026, Built and tested): A webhook service that transcribes lesson videos with speaker separation and returns structured JSON scoring teacher quality and student engagement.
- AI Email Campaigns (2026, Built and tested): Fill in a form with a contact list and, for a job search, your CV. Each contact gets an email written for them, sent one at a time through Gmail with a random pause, and you get a report when it is done.
- CRM Lead Cleaner (2026, Built and tested): Incoming CRM leads arrive scattered (duplicates, malformed emails, missing fields) and cost sales teams hours of manual triage. This pipeline cleans them automatically and reports on what it did.

## Websites built for clients

- [Aya Rady](https://nouraldeentofi.com/sites/aya-rady/): Personal branding strategist for experts and consultants. On arrival a search plays out: look-alike results blur away and one name rises through her three verbs, remembered, trusted, chosen. Inside-Out, her programme drawn as rings, now opens her method.
- [Mohammed Alhabbarah](https://nouraldeentofi.com/sites/mohammed-alhabbarah/): Head of Learning & Capability Development, Riyadh Metro. Arrival on a platform: a split-flap board flips his name, his role and his destination, operational readiness, while a small train calls at the stages of his work; then the platform doors slide open onto the page. Behind every page, a living metro map.
- [Layal Joumaa](https://nouraldeentofi.com/sites/layal-joumaa/): CV writer, LinkedIn optimisation and personal branding. Her craft is the opening: a red pen sharpens a sample CV, the page folds into a paper plane and flies across a dotted map to where her clients landed, then opens on her real profile. No photos: a pen mark, a one-page CV and a letter that writes itself.
- [Salam Aksimi](https://nouraldeentofi.com/sites/salam-aksimi/): Personal branding and content on LinkedIn. The post that lands: her own hook types itself into a post, she publishes, the card lifts out of the feed while reactions float up and ripples spread, then a spark flies to the booking button. Threads and sparks run behind every page.
- [Tawheed Malkat](https://nouraldeentofi.com/sites/tawheed-malkat/): Product designer (UI/UX). The portfolio as a design file that never stops working: on arrival the hero designs itself, one of her skills at a time (research, wireframe, type, colour, prototype).
- [Monther Al-Ashqar](https://nouraldeentofi.com/sites/monther-al-ashqar/): Senior project manager and owner's representative. The hero is an engineering sheet: a tower elevation draws itself floor by floor while a progress S-curve falls behind plan, recovers and lands on completion, and a handed-over stamp settles.
- [Othman Almashaqba](https://nouraldeentofi.com/sites/othman-almashaqba/): Technology leader, ERP and IT governance, Riyadh. Threads arrive tangled at the start of the line and leave as ordered lanes once they pass behind his portrait, the way he puts a process in order before he automates it. A band of them heads every page and straightens further as you scroll.
- [Dr. Hamad Al-Thiapi](https://nouraldeentofi.com/sites/hamad-al-thiapi/): AI and digital transformation leader in government. Convergence: gold routes cross a night sky over Najd and all meet at his portrait, with light travelling along them, the way networks settle on one path, the subject of his doctorate. Najdi parapets edge every section.
- [Mazen Alobaidi](https://nouraldeentofi.com/sites/mazen-alobaidi/): General manager, IT and digital transformation. The stack: in the hero, isometric planes float one above another, server boxes and databases below and a target on top, while gold pulses climb between the layers. On the home page his roles stack the same way, each tagged with its layer, and a light climbs from his first role to today.
- [Ayman Alawwad](https://nouraldeentofi.com/sites/ayman-alawwad/): PMO manager, portfolio and program governance. Drafted on linen: behind the page a portfolio roadmap draws itself in ink, task bars, dependency lines and diamond milestones, while a red status line drifts slowly across the plan. Linen and ink come from his LinkedIn banner, the deep red from his shemagh.
- [TechSpark Karam](https://nouraldeentofi.com/sites/karam/): A young creator and explorer, inspiring kids to love technology. A night sky for a young tech fan: words like HTML, JS, Robots and Gaming drift down behind the page, his TechSpark badge glows at the centre, and a typewriter spells out TechSpark Karam, coding fun, cool gadgets and future tech in turn.
- [Gambit Tournaments](https://gambit.nouraldeentofi.com/): Tournaments platform for a chess club in Dammam. The club's black and gold, built as a full product: upcoming tournaments with live seats, guest registration, and an archive of past tournaments.
- [Al-Bader Transport](https://nouraldeentofi.com/sites/albader-transport/): Transport, logistics and contracting, Madinah. Al-Bader is the full moon, so the site opens at night: the logo's three road lines sweep in and climb into a moon, then the night folds into the hero's moon over Madinah, with Uhud on the horizon, city lights, and long-exposure trails on the highway. Further down, lights travel along route lanes and a truck drives from step to step.
- [Arabian Access](https://nouraldeentofi.com/sites/arabian-access/): Business setup consultancy, Riyadh. Built on their logo: two waves in two colours, the firm and its client, moving together. They flow through the hero and draw themselves across the stages of the work, over the star lattice etched on the glass of their Al Malaz reception, with points of light travelling along its lines. The real reception photo drifts in a slow zoom beside a glass card that steps through the setup journey.
- [Saudi Brothers](https://nouraldeentofi.com/sites/saudi-brothers-hajj/): Hajj services for domestic pilgrims, Makkah and Al-Qassim. From Al-Qassim to the holy sites. A gold eight-pointed star draws itself, the Talbiyah appears word by word, and the page opens from the heart of the star. The hero is a living scene of Arafat's mountains, the tents of Mina and the dunes, under a rising dawn sun in light mode and a crescent, stars and tent lights in dark.
- [Al-Hemaya Al-Kamela](https://nouraldeentofi.com/sites/alhemaya-alkamela/): Fire alarm and fire suppression systems, Khamis Mushait. The site is a fire alarm control panel. Each section is a zone with its own lamp, which blinks amber while it is checked and settles green as you reach it, and an LCD readout in the header names the zone. Behind the hero, flow runs through a sprinkler network past pressure gauges; the inspection request is a hanging tag, and the company's history is an engraved equipment data plate.
- [Prestige VIP Tailor](https://nouraldeentofi.com/sites/prestige-vip-tailor/): Men's tailor, Al Khobar. Cut to measure: tailor's chalk drafts the thobe pattern, a tape measures it and a running stitch closes it, then the cloth fills in and becomes the thobe on its hanger, beside a fabric swatch book in 3D.
- [Al-Reem Grilled Lamb](https://nouraldeentofi.com/sites/alreem-mashwi/): Charcoal-grilled lamb, Al Khobar. Live coals: the hero opens at night, then the charcoal catches. Embers and sparks rise off the real coals, warm light flickers on the lamb, and the headline glows and cools. On the phone it works like an app: a bottom bar and an order in steps.
- [Portfolio Gallery](https://nouraldeentofi.com/gallery/): 120 portfolio designs. Personas, scroll stories, interactive machines and whole worlds (a city builder, a solar system, a museum, a stock exchange), each one a single hand-crafted HTML file.
